verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of trace sampling configuration, log sampling, or retention tiers. Community posts only describe on/off switches for default log collection: agent env vars and a 'log settings' toggle in the Data Management Hub. Those are adjacent controls, not sampling or retention-tier management, and one user reports irrelevant metrics and logs were hard to filter.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
